claim.statement: Ketchup captures stdout and stderr of every instance on its node, serves cluster-wide queries and live follow through any node, and exports Parquet archives that SQL can query.
claim.measurable: relish logs <app> from each node returns the same merged lines; -f shows [node instance] prefixes and picks up replicas scheduled to new nodes; a node that fails to answer yields a warning line on stderr (timeout 10 s) while other nodes' lines still arrive; retention_days default 7, export_interval_secs default 3600.
